criteria.statement: Browser relay EVENT frames are validated before subscription callbacks receive them.
tests: web/tests/unit/sanity.test.js: validates NIP-01 event hashes before browser consumers receive relay EVENT frames
web/tests/unit/sanity.test.js: rejects malformed signatures, timestamps, and non-string tags at the inbound validator

criteria.statement: Browser historical queries resolve only after all connected relays in the subscription snapshot emit EOSE.
tests: web/tests/unit/sanity.test.js: preserves relay frame order when EVENT validation is followed immediately by EOSE
web/tests/unit/sanity.test.js: resolves historical queries only after every connected relay sends EOSE

criteria.statement: Timeout, abort, and relay-closed-incomplete paths reject with a distinct incomplete-history error and preserve partial events/relay state.
tests: web/tests/unit/sanity.test.js: treats query timeouts as incomplete history instead of successful partial results
web/tests/unit/sanity.test.js: treats aborts as incomplete history with typed reason metadata
web/tests/unit/sanity.test.js: rejects closed-incomplete queries and preserves partial events for callers
web/tests/unit/nostr-client-parsing.test.js: rejects pending bootstrap queries when a relay transport closes before EOSE

criteria.statement: Branch and control-plane callers surface incomplete history/relay closure explicitly instead of treating it as empty success.
tests: web/tests/unit/test-utils-and-fixtures.test.js: returns an explicit degraded error when branch history is incomplete before EOSE
web/tests/unit/controlplane-requests.test.js: awaitResult reports auth-related subscription closures distinctly
web/tests/unit/controlplane-requests.test.js: awaitResult aggregates relay close reasons when all result subscriptions close incomplete
